evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Operational rule declared as settled policy — 'run monthly from now on' performs the settling; the second sentence elevates it toward principle but the segment's act is declarative ratification, so decision is the supported level.
Cadence specification presented as a settled operational parameter, not a proposal — the assertive act and fixed-schedule framing ratify the monthly cadence as decided.
Owner assignment is a ratification act — naming the accountable party performs the settling of who owns the rehearsed rollback, a decision-grade performed declarative.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that an unrehearsed capability is no capability at all — treating rehearsal as constitutive of possession?
